page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Printed page number at the top left. Running head at the top, in heavy black type. Handwritten annotation in the left margin (not printed, not transcribed).

main_text.p: ra & capita putemus esse,bre uiter exponendum est. Ac mihi quidem in eam cogitationem totum hoc triennium incumbenti, fontesque cōtro-uersiarum omnium diligenter exquirenti, tria tantum usque adhuc animaduertere licuit. Nasci enim controuersias animaduerti uel ex iure, uel ex scripto, uel ex uerbo. Ex iure, cum aut æquitas cū iure, aut ius scriptum cum non scripto contēdit. Ex scripto, cum aut scriptum, id est locutionis genus, ambiguū est: aut sententia cum scripto comparatur: aut cōtrariè scripta reperiuntur. quod Anto-ni-

page.notes: Handwritten annotation in the left margin ("Genera ... licuit" area), not printed; excluded. Running head is decorative and illegible; transcribed as a placeholder. Page number printed as "9ò" with a stylised final letter, read as 90 [?]. The word "trienniu" may carry a macron over the u (trienniū); the scan is unclear, so it is given as printed. Text in the first line begins mid-sentence; the paragraph continues from the previous page. The final word "Anto-ni-" is hyphenated at the line end and continues onto the next page.
